title: CDT Environmental Technology Investment Holdings Limited Announces Closing of Initial Public Offering
description: SHENZHEN, China, April  22, 2024  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CDT Environmental Technology Investment Holdings Limited (“CDT”), a waste treatment company that designs, develops, manufactures, sells, installs, operates and maintains sewage treatment systems and provides sewage treatment services in China, announces the closing of its underwritten initial public offering of 1,500,000 ordinary shares at a public offering price of $4.00 per share, before underwriting discounts and commissions, resulting in gross proceeds of $6,000,000, before underwriting discounts and commissions and offering expenses. The offering was conducted on a firm commitment basis. All of the ordinary shares were offered by CDT.
